note: All claims PROPOSED. No model has run. No empirical evidence exists yet.

claims.text: A CAS probe reads a CAS coordinate from the model that generalizes to a held-out split and beats surface, metadata, shuffled-label, matched-non-CAS, and random-same-rank controls.
A computed intervention moves the requested CAS coordinate AND improves exact agent/patient role accuracy, beating random and ordinary matched-norm directions.
A profile-specific CAS-Ohm response fit predicts held-out movement within the preregistered tolerance and beats zero/mean/linear/affine/quadratic baselines on a disjoint split.
The whole method reduces examples-to-threshold, optimizer steps, compute, or forgetting versus matched ordinary LoRA and consolidation baselines.
The software correctly implements a local regularized right-inverse on synthetic matrices under declared rank conditions.
